cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the complication. I'd like us still sharing a table when the money arrives.

confusable: D63 protects a balance of power; D87 protects the relationship from another conflict over a concealed truth.
comparison: A proposed bank call differs from direct access to a repayment letter at breakfast.
seedUse: Use D87-b banking-complication euphemism, repeated family loan question and separate-bedroom history as the concealment stakes.
